name: Can I convert my existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my existing bathtub into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing bathtub into a walk-in shower is a common renovation project. This conversion typically involves removing the tub, modifying plumbing for a new drain location and showerhead, waterproofing the area, and installing new shower pan, walls, and glass enclosures. It's an excellent way to update your bathroom, improve accessibility, and create a more modern aesthetic without extensive structural changes. We assess your current bathroom layout to determine the most efficient and effective conversion strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can convert an existing bathtub into a walk-in shower by removing the tub, modifying plumbing, and installing new shower components.
